verdict.rationale: Base44 offers AI-driven design previews before changes are applied (base44-docs-14) and community praise for quick iteration with two-prompt builds (base44-comm-6), suggesting some safeguard against breaking existing work. However, other community feedback describes hitting walls and escalating costs when trying to get the AI to iterate further (base44-comm-8), and no explicit versioning/rollback mechanism for prompt-based edits is documented.
